lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters, with higher spatial density observed in the anterior region posterior to the gill slits, transitioning to larger, more isolated nodes toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition with bright upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the visible macro-mask of the dorsal fin, primarily concentrated toward the base and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in spot morphology characterized by dense, miniaturized pixel clusters on the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits, relative to the larger nodes on the lateral body.
